name: audit

test_list.description: When no stress plan is supplied, audit only uses deterministic AST and DFA checks.
When a stress plan is supplied, each bounded input is sent through SandboxBackend::exec.
No model dependency exists and report token usage is private with a zero-only constructor.
A nonzero exit status remains runtime evidence and is not promoted to a diagnosed bug.

inputs.name: stress
inputs.description: Optional bounded command and boundary corpus.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: SDK SandboxBackend selected by the composition root.

output_description: Static findings and optional bounded dynamic observations with honest zero model-token usage.
